subject: Account trajectory check: Cobalt Health expansion verification
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Account trajectory check: Cobalt Health expansion verification

Team —

Quick hygiene check on the Cobalt Health expansion (RWF-2027-0532). Finance asked us to confirm stage and expected close date for the Q3 forecast. I want to keep the motion tidy so numbers are accurate for next week’s commit review. Can each of you confirm the following by EOD today:  

- Current forecasted ARR increase and which SKUs are in scope (dedicated capacity, Optimize seats, etc.)
- Confident close date (we need a day, not a range)
- Any dependencies blocking contract signing (SOW, procurement PO, security artifacts)

I’ve attached the working MAP I pulled together — please update the close date in the sheet and add one-line notes if there’s risk to the amount. I’ll compile responses and share a single-row summary to finance.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0168
Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Account trajectory check: Cobalt Health expansion verification

Hannah — thanks for flagging. Quick data from my side:  

- Net new ARR we’re tracking: $420,000 ARR (12-month contract)
  - Redwood Dedicated: $300k ARR (reserved capacity, 8x nodes)
  - Redwood Optimize (enterprise plan): $120k ARR
- Current internal close target: 2027-08-26 (customer expects procurement to complete in late Aug)
- Outstanding dependencies: signed SOW + PO from procurement; legal has no material open redlines after last pass.

I updated the MAP sheet (row 4) with the $420k and new close date. I also added a short note under Risks: "Procurement queue; finance wants final order by 07/30 to book in Q3 — customer has asked for a final quote and payment terms."

Next steps I’m owning: finalize order form, push SOW to Elena and procurement, coordinate with Marissa for adoption milestones. I’ll set a 15-min sync with Elena if you want — propose Thu morning.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.com

Attachment referenced: MAP-Cobalt-2027Q3.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Account trajectory check: Cobalt Health expansion verification

+1 to Diego’s note. A couple of operational items from CS: 

- Adoption checkpoints: we need completion of the Dedicated onboarding (data migration and perf validation) before we flip billing to committed capacity. Current projection for onboarding completion: 2027-08-15 (depends on customer resources).
- Health score: 72 — moderate. Product usage is increasing but a few feature flags still toggled off by the customer team.
- SOW: I reviewed SOW-draft-v3.pdf (internal copy) — we should insert the milestone tied to "production KV migration" as a gating item for the first billing milestone.

If finance needs the deal in Q3 and procurement won’t sign until end of Aug, there’s a risk to revenue recognition timing. Recommend we mark stage as "Commit (subject to PO)" in the tracker and include the procurement ETA.

I’ll own onboarding milestones and will provide a short artifact for finance showing the milestone dates and owners by EOD Thu.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment referenced: SOW-draft-v3.pdf

From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@cobalthealth.com>

Hi Diego / Marissa / Hannah —

Thanks for the summary. Procurement is now in the loop and they requested the final SOW and order form to begin internal approvals. We have executive approval for the expansion in principle; final sign-off depends on procurement clearing the funding.

Requests from our side: 
- Please send the updated order form with explicit billing milestones and acceptance criteria (we need these for our budget approvers).
- Can you confirm the final price (including any one-time onboarding fees) and payment terms?
- We have internal procurement deadlines: if the PO request is submitted by 2027-07-30 we can expedite; otherwise it will slide into the Sep cycle.

I’m attaching a short internal approval note from our CFO so you can see the cadence. Happy to hop on a quick call Thu if helpful — I’m available 11:00–12:00 ET.

Best,
Elena Ramos
VP, Cloud Infrastructure | Cobalt Health
elena.ramos@cobalthealth.com

Team — quick finance note: if we want to include this in Q3 booked revenue, we need an executed order form with PO or payment initiation by 2027-07-30. If procurement can only submit after 07/30 we should push to a Q3 deferred revenue note and reflect as "Commit (PO pending)" in the forecast.

Ask from revenue ops: please provide the finalized order form (fillable PDF or DocuSign) and an explicit billing schedule. Also include which billing entity the customer will use (legal name + tax ID) — procurement usually includes that. I’ll standby to fast-track once we have the DocuSign link.

Ben Carter

Subject: Re: Account trajectory check: Cobalt Health expansion verification — next steps

Thanks everyone — good alignment. Quick summary and owners so finance has a single source of truth for the commit review: 

- Finalize order form and DocuSign link (Owner: Diego) — due 2027-07-28
- Insert billing milestones + acceptance criteria in SOW (Owner: Marissa) — due 2027-07-28
- Customer to submit PO by 2027-07-30 to enable Q3 booking (Owner: Elena / Procurement)
- Revenue ops to stand by to process order and confirm billing entity when DocuSign completed (Owner: Ben)

Action items for commit deck: Diego, please send the single-line forecast row I can drop into the commit spreadsheet: stage value (Commit vs Commit-PO-pending), ARR delta, close date. Marissa, please attach the onboarding milestone list as a separate artifact.

I’ll schedule a 20-min sync for Mon 07/26 10:00 PT to reconcile if needed (calendar invite to follow). If PO arrives before then we’ll mark as booked.

Hannah
